extracted.intended_audience: general readers and those interested in literary/religious criticism (late-19th-century American audiences, students of Mark Twain and Christian Science)
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter/essay-length critical examination of Christian Science and Mary Baker Eddy, arguing historical, doctrinal, and institutional points and providing satirical commentary. Aimed as a polemic and character-portrait rather than a how-to or guideline.
